reasons.correctness: Adds @Version Long version and a BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 column, matching the interface; 2/2 acceptance pass. UserPreferencesDtoIn carries no version, so a stale save from another device is caught only inside one request's load-save window.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset header reads '-- Liquibase formatted SQL' and '-- changeset', not the prescribed '--liquibase formatted sql' / '--changeset'. File path, name, rollback and changelog.xml comment follow the rule. No new *UnitTest class.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one annotated entity field, one changeset, one changelog include. No new mechanism; it follows the existing @Version pattern from AppliedOpportunity.
reasons.test_quality: No new *UnitTest class. Two tests appended to UserPreferencesServiceUnitTest only check the Lombok getter and setter for version. Nothing checks locking behaviour or the @Version annotation.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query found the userpreferences files; the second returned one path. The @Version exemplar, the changeset and the exception handling were found by grep and reading directories.
